title: Give the big picture first, then details

body.text: what the app does + which screens/features it has + the rough style
. Don't dive into every detail yet — let Lovable build the structure first, then refine piece by piece, like sketching before coloring.

example: Build a restaurant table-booking app: a screen to pick date/time and party size, and a confirmation screen, warm tone

title: See the live preview and iterate

body.text: immediately. If it's not right, type the changes point by point. The workflow is to iterate, not to get it all in one command. The more concrete you are, the more on-target the result.

example: Make the confirm button bigger and green, and move it to the center of the screen
